body: character reference sheet T-POSE, straight-on front view -- a chibi VOXEL-BLOCK toy figure (like a collectible vinyl block toy, NOT a soft cartoon illustration, NOT a children's-book style, NO visible smooth skin-toned face) of a hooded young scribe, BOTH ARMS RAISED STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height, elbows fully straight, a large visible gap between each arm and the torso, both blocky hands open with fingers spread, nothing held, fully visible in frame. Big blocky head, short stubby blocky body, made of assembled rectangular blocks, every part a flat rectangular block with hard 90-degree edges, bold thick black outline stroke around every edge and seam, flat hard-contrast shading (NOT soft airbrushed gradients, NOT a rosy-cheeked cartoon kid). Legs straight, shoulder-width apart. Matte dark navy-black blocky hooded scholar coat that shadows the face (only glowing eyes visible in the hood shadow, no visible skin), thick TEAL-CYAN trim block accents along the cuffs and hem, a rolled scroll block on the back, a small dagger block sheathed flat at the hip, blocky boots. Flat toy-voxel render style like a plastic collectible figure, single flat even lighting, plain flat grey background, generous empty margin so nothing is cropped, no text, no logos, no watermark
